round: Review A remediation F19: real WCAG contrast ratios
green_command: CI=true pnpm --filter www-reading-advantage exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=dot
note: All four gates exited 0 through heavy-run. The new contrast fixture and its unit test add three cases, so the count rises from 1385 to 1388. Line coverage is 91.64 percent, above the 85.52 floor and the 86.52 baseline. The isDarkText helper was removed from both R2 contrast tests. Each now uses contrastOf from fixtures/contrast.ts, which parses hex, rgb(a) and oklch from the real compiled CSS, resolves the background from the element and its ancestors, blends alpha, and throws on an unresolved foreground. The unit test pins that rgb(120,120,120) on #faf9f7 is below 4.5, that black on white is 21, and that an unparseable colour throws. Two mutation proofs show a low-contrast production class fails the target test; each production edit was restored and git status shows no production change. The lint log holds zero errors and three known warnings in files this commit does not touch.
